147-643-8199.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Brigid's Command
147-643-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brigid's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Brigid's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-643-8199.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

394-586-864-3125-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

301-1768-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and Juniper Order Ranger
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

640-2112-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-2112-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hound of Griselbrand.
Hound of Griselbrand dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Hound of Griselbrand trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hound of Griselbrand, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-7291--146.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7291--146.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature that has haste.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

967-2557-3809-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

38-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
38-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

511-817-3000-3062-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Squirrel and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

5670-6720-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6720-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1251-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3951-6473.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Mardu Siegebreaker.
You have two or more opponents.
3951-6473.description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating at least two token copies of Éomer that is tapped and attacking.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Éomer token(s) die, you will get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3334-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3334-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3334-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

116-1636-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-1636-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

144-1636-2034-4319.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

1812-2232-2440-3433.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cloudstone Curio each trigger four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {5} for each Insect you control.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

564-628-2034.notablePrerequisites: Monoskelion does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
564-628-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Monoskelion, adding {C}{C}.
When Monoskelion dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Monoskelion twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2048-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

654-774-2137-5175.notablePrerequisites:
High Tide in hand.You control at least two Islands.
"Blue" chosen with Caged Sun.
654-774-2137-5175.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Caged Sun triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two Islands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two Islands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.

594-1107-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
594-1107-2034.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Crab enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

643-876-2525-4421-4951.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
643-876-2525-4421-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Body Double's toughness.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Body Double.
Activate Body Double by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.

221-1012-2393-2579-3977-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature with total power and toughness equal to seven in library.
221-1012-2393-2579-3977-5231.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Thermopod and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Thermopod dies, triggering Sifter of Skulls and The Cauldron of Eternity.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting the creature on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2726-4050-4512-4871.description:
Cast Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {B}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Sanitarium Skeleton.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sanitarium Skeleton and the Sanitarium Skeleton token, adding {2}.
The Sanitarium Skeletons die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1703-2880-3783-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control another Illusion with power five or greater.
1703-2880-3783-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Illusion with power five or greater, adding one mana of any color.
The Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Dreadmaw, adding one mana of any color.
Phantasmal Dreadmaw dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Phantasmal Dreadmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Repeat from step 3.

751-2034-3263-3841.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake for {1}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier token, adding {2}.
Repeat.

413-1447-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Human" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
413-1447-4192.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise triggers, and Blasting Station triggers once for each creature returned this way.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.
